_comment: Per-finding-type regression floor for the FIXTURE gate. Baselines are the analyzer's ACTUAL measured precision/recall on the curated fixtures (see labels.json). Values below 1.0 encode KNOWN, documented analyzer behaviour: command_injection/dead_function precision 0.66 = over-flagging safe subprocess.run(list) and __main__ entrypoints; unsafe_deserialization recall 0.33 = misses pickle.load and yaml.load. The gate fails if any type drops BELOW these floors.
